top_categories.workout_context: Granfondo Ecuador's mixed terrain rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Granfondo Ecuador's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before November.

Road-specific control matters at Granfondo Ecuador. Practice on mixed terrain: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 79 miles.
79 miles on mixed terrain burns energy faster than the distance suggests. Train the fade resistance now.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Granfondo Ecuador. Train it until it feels boring.
At Granfondo Ecuador, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
When someone attacks on mixed terrain, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
Double-threshold training builds sustained power with less fatigue. More FTP per hour of training.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Granfondo Ecuador. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Granfondo Ecuador's mixed terrain actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on mixed terrain. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
76–85% FTP for extended efforts. At Granfondo Ecuador, tempo is the floor you'll live on. Make it feel easy.

race_overlay.weather: November in Salinas, Santa Elena, Ecuador. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Granfondo Ecuador. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Use training to rehearse an eating and drinking plan for Granfondo Ecuador's 79 miles. Start early and use products you tolerate. The organizer has not published a reliable resupply plan, so rehearse a self-sufficient carry and revise it when the rider document is released.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Granfondo Ecuador rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mixed terrain to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Race Simulation, and Road Specific to prepare you for 79 miles of mixed terrain in Salinas, Santa Elena, Ecuador.
